changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and normalized the guideline descriptions. Normalized criteria by removing duplicates and case variations. The paper clearly uses both head-to-head preference comparisons and accuracy judgments as human evaluation criteria.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on generating natural language answers and rationales for questions about image edits, which qualifies as NLG. The evaluation uses both automatic metrics (Perplexity, ROUGE, METEOR, Accuracy) and human evaluation (head-to-head preference and accuracy judgments). No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used. The main tasks are Image Captioning and Visual Question Answering applied to understanding image edits.
